title: Replication package: Limited-label updating of an adult depressive-symptom model across NHANES survey periods
description: Reviewer replication package (code, unit tests, frozen configurations, participant-split/updating-sample manifests, aggregate table CSVs, and audit reports) for 'Limited-label updating of an adult depressive-symptom model across NHANES survey periods: a survey-weighted transport study'. Raw NHANES XPT files are downloaded directly from CDC NCHS via src/download_data.py.
